title: I Don't Edit Video. I Compile It. — narration
notes: Eight lines, one per chapter: line i retimes chapter i of the picture.
Captions are headlines and may differ from the spoken text; only the count
has to match, because the film maps voice line i onto caption i.
gap_before on line 1 is the walk-in: the figure must be on its mark before
the first word, not talking while it walks.
pause_after is the air between chapters; the cut lands CUT_LEAD before the
next line, so the frame has already changed when the syllable arrives.

lines.text: A brief becomes direction. Direction becomes frames.
Every frame is code, drawn rather than found.
Sound is mixed by number, not by ear.
Then the film audits itself, before anyone watches it.
No cloud, no render farm, no timeline.
